pos.personaBrief: Fast vertical transitions, 'posse não é suficiente' (2018) and Trivela 2025 saying he doesn't prize possession control; yet he likes the ball in the opponent's half.

pro.personaBrief: 'Na dúvida tem que quebrar' near his box (2025), quick vertical touches to the last third and Fernandinho counter-attacks (Goal 2017) point to direct, fast progression.

est.personaBrief: Constant position swaps to confuse marking (90min 2020 quote), Pepê/Jean Pyerre drifting, quick short combinations on the right in 2025 favour relational play over fixed zones.

lar.personaBrief: Used 4-2-3-1 without wingers and a losango in 2023, wants full-backs going inside, wingers cutting into the box; but also relied on fast wide forwards for counters.

blo.personaBrief: States high marking and pressure at Fluminense 2025 and Cano leading the press, though he also dropped lines at times (Grêmio 2024, Flamengo vs Galo).

mar.personaBrief: Individual encaixes at Grêmio 2024 (Kannemann chasing Arias and Ganso), Ignácio on Vegetti, Canobbio marking a full-back; man-oriented tendencies.

pla.personaBrief: Has 'opção A, B e C', changed to a back three to mirror Inter and hired Canobbio to mark a full-back; adapts shape to context and players.

res.personaBrief: Competitive, 'malandro' Libertadores mindset, closes games with a line of five late (2025), prioritises winning over how.

sis.personaBrief: 'Quem sabe, sabe'; freedom for players to express themselves and rely on individual talent, but 'pago para correr' and Cano doing defensive duels show duties for all.

jog.personaBrief: Intense training and fighters ('não adianta ser bom tecnicamente e não correr'), set-piece and height focus, yet still gives room to creative meias like Jean Pyerre, Cristaldo and Ganso.

bas.personaBrief: Complemented squads with seasoned players (Léo Moura, Cortez, Jael, Maicon, Geromel), revives veterans; prefers fighters over unproven kids.

lid.personaBrief: Boleiro manager who talks as an equal and keeps a light atmosphere, but demands more, rotates stars like Marchesín and keeps the final word.
